recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24668 unless the work group separately revisits the MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement naming history.
issue_request: FHIR-24668 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to update MedicationUsage.derivedFrom from generic supporting-information wording to "Link to information used to derive the MedicationUsage" for R5.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 2933d19faad5a9c3da59470ac68ba7222b4495d7, which changed source/medicationusage/medicationusage-spreadsheet.xml so the derivedFrom short description became "Link to information used to derive the MedicationUsage" while leaving the longer definition and comments intact.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is the active current build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/fhir.ini records MedicationStatement.supportingInformation as renamed to MedicationStatement.derivedFrom. Later FHIR-38682 source history renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement and introduced the current StructureDefinition with the same requested short text under the current resource name. Direct Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no competing discussion or minutes for this small Pharmacy wording change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml already says <short value="Link to information used to derive the MedicationStatement"/> for MedicationStatement.derivedFrom.

related_jiras.note: Renamed current-source instances of MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement, explaining why the FHIR-24668 text now uses the MedicationStatement resource name.
